nodes.name: List Businesses
nodes.notes: Add your Google place_ids and business names here. Each business will be processed in sequence.

nodes.name: Fetch Google Reviews
nodes.notes:
Uses Google Places API (New). Create an HTTP Header Auth credential with:
  Name: X-Goog-Api-Key
  Value: YOUR_GOOGLE_API_KEY

Get your API key from: https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials
Enable 'Places API (New)' in your GCP project.

nodes.name: Send to DialectIQ API
nodes.notes:
Sends each review to DialectIQ for:
1. Saudi dialect detection (Najdi/Hijazi/Sharqi/MSA/Arabizi)
2. Sentiment analysis (1-10 score)
3. Category + urgency classification
4. Auto-reply generation in Arabic

2s delay between requests to respect Claude API rate limits.
